services.name: Helicopter Ride
services.desc: Experience Niagara Falls like never before, from new heights. Soar above the breathtaking Horseshoe Falls, American Falls, and the Niagara River, enjoying panoramic views you can’t get anywhere else. This unforgettable experience offers a bird’s-eye perspective of the waterfalls, surrounding landscapes, and even the city skyline. Experience the breathtaking beauty of Niagara Falls like never before with a thrilling helicopter ride in Niagara Falls, Canada. Soar 3,000 feet above the iconic falls and take in panoramic, awe-inspiring views of the Niagara region, Power Hydro Stations, Niagara River, and the three waterfalls: Canadian Horshoe, American Falls, and the Bridal Veils Falls. services.desc: Get up close to the amazing Niagara Falls with Niagara City Cruises - the official Niagara fllas boat tour in Canada. Step onto a safe, modern boat and take the Voyage to the Falls, where you’ll sail right to the base of the huge Horseshoe Falls. Feel the mist on your face and hear the roar of the water as you see the Falls from the best view possible. You’ll get a free poncho to help keep you dry. Want something even more special? Try the Falls Fireworks Cruise in the evening, with the Falls lit up and fireworks lighting the sky. It’s a fun and exciting trip for all ages. blurb: Airlink Tours offers guided bus and private tours from Toronto to Niagara Falls, including transportation, skip-the-line access to attractions, and optional meals. Tours include visits to Niagara City Cruises boat tour, Journey Behind the Falls, Skylon Tower, and other local sights. Private tours offer customizable itineraries and door-to-door service.
